body:
Van’s native margin reads previously lacked a durable, request-bound path through both MT5 transports. This draft adds that path while retaining original account identity, exact quantities/prices, deadlines, replay and recovery. Current source: `42d8b386e61f2ea26730d4232cab494b3173320e`.

The signed Windows worker reads native isolated-order margin without calling order_check or order_send. It validates original product/side/quantity/price, native increments, account/model/precision and expiry before and after I/O. The EA source implements the corresponding capability-bound MARGIN_QUOTE read, identity-bound 18-field deadline frame, native binary64 metadata and explicit UTC-second uncertainty. Expired queued reads are refused; read operations remain distinct from entry claims.

Both public adapters feed the existing SQL NativeMarginBook. Original native request nonce or queue ID, account context, request/response and money scope survive restart and independent readback. Lost storage acknowledgement recovers the original durable record without a second native read. Actual zero, unavailable, stale, foreign and malformed observations remain distinct.

These are isolated estimates excluding existing positions and pending orders. They issue no reservation, settlement, provider qualification or execution grant. Native Python SDK/EA calculations in Linux tests use explicit source fixtures. Actual terminal/provider behavior and deployment remain unqualified.

Earlier source retains exact cash-backed collateral bounds, all-alias pending/partial/uncertain command exposure, shared physical-account baselines/streaks, original own-alias equity and signed alias-scoped recovery. Current configuration cannot rewrite earlier account ownership or financial history. A held read or commit-ACK failure cannot resurrect another alias’s displayed peak after a signed reset or erase independently observed native equity. Original policy readback retains actual standing-signature/public-key/effective-policy evidence, including the separately signed temperament input; it returns immutable historical data outside TradingMandate and cannot reactivate a current grant.

The branch preserves earlier alert controls, screens/watchlists, account/funding and order recovery, market/news/depth, governed-learning/research, assistant/provider/privacy/reminder/voice and inherited Android work. Each is partial source work; none implies whole-feature acceptance.

## Validation

- **1,050 actual source/SQLite/PostgreSQL/signed-HTTP/queue/worker/recovery/protection cases passed, zero skips or storage-audit findings.** All 1,050 unique call identities executed once. All 1,218 pinned source hashes matched, including the actual deploy worker.py and EA.mq5. Owned PostgreSQL was independently confirmed removed. The 144-case focused selection overlaps.
- Failed decoder attempts remain recorded: 51 passes/one failure and 110 passes/the same failure. Foreign scope was already refused; the pure decoder’s exception contract was normalized to ValueError. Original controls/assertions remain.
- **Actual native MetaEditor compilation of the exact modified EA passed** in [run 40651126241](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/actions/runs/40651126241). Source SHA-256 `9a8ab7349deba1c1fd492b056457f808c0876bbd69ff7a0aaa5f783ddc64bc50` and Git blob match this commit despite the runner using its synthetic merge head. Official installer/compiler signatures were Valid. The EA produced a fresh binary with zero errors and zero warnings; deliberately invalid source produced four errors and no binary. Original archive size/digest/CRC/paths and extracted log/binary hashes were independently checked. The native compiler’s reported process exit 1 is retained; the job validates actual logs and fresh output rather than assuming exit-code semantics. This is source compilation, not a live account/order/device test.
- Genuine Project Truth hook passed using the existing candidate-build/native-worker source authorization records. Required-baseline committed verification finished with **actual exit 0, GREEN185** against `4fd466dec3910ed5de614bfbf95887ad619df5ca`. Normal push and independent remote readback match the exact head.
- Real manifest: **9,833 files, zero mismatches**. Owner/frontend registries are unchanged; consolidation has zero findings. Mutation preflight validates 374 identities/383 edits; it is not local execution of that corpus.
- Prior original-policy qualification passed 766 source/SQL/HTTP/authority cases, zero skips/audit findings, with its 1,210 pinned inputs. Selections overlap and retain their original scope.

Exact-head [main 40651126263](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/actions/runs/40651126263) and cognitive 40651126245 are running at last readback; forecast 40651126310, kernel 40651126247 and MQL 40651126241 succeeded. No complete main-suite qualification is claimed yet.

Parent `9c19f375` has all 17 public jobs successful and two mandatory admission jobs failed. Original failed logs confirm the private DDS read key is not provisioned and the trusted main checkout lacks the Project Truth checker. Those prerequisites remain unwaived. Parent E12 independently verified 4,708 trading passes/one declared DDS skip, 26 PostgreSQL passes and 117 voice passes. All earlier failed runs retain their original revision and status.

## Remaining programme

The backend is incomplete. All 12 backend-verification packets remain open and all 131 formal unit acceptances remain unissued. The frozen programme retains 131 units, 324 requirements, 1,610 acceptance identities, 234 contexts, 349 actions and 93 features; the original Android baseline retains 42 feature groups, 105 functions and 78 surfaces.

Next: actual account-wide funding/order/manual reservations, pending-risk enforcement, current active-policy arbitration, authoritative native fill/cancel/finality/release, flow adjustment, payment approval through reserve/send/settle/compensate, manual trading and handover/provider reconciliation. Source readers do not replace these required effects.

The complete unchanged programme also includes native instruments/feeds/depth/news/calendars/entitlements/charts/alerts/replay/voice; trading-outcome learning and every forecast/research unit; crypto/CEX/chain/wallet/finality/prediction markets; Hermes/Muse/JEV/browser/artifacts/projects/memory/privacy/automation/notifications; security, capacity, deployment and backup/recovery; then independent qualification and Android acceptance. Profitability is evaluated with evidence and never guaranteed.

Van trading core remains the chosen host. Android must use its provisioned production profile without owner-entered backend addresses. New frontend design remains behind BG-001. Production provisioning/signing, actual Artemis/Samsung S24 Ultra acceptance and native/provider/economic qualification remain unissued.

See the [execution method](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/blob/42d8b386e61f2ea26730d4232cab494b3173320e/docs/rebuild/rev118/BUILD_EXECUTION_PLAN.md), [full scope workmap](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/blob/42d8b386e61f2ea26730d4232cab494b3173320e/docs/rebuild/rev118/SOURCE_WORKMAP.json), [source receipt](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/blob/42d8b386e61f2ea26730d4232cab494b3173320e/docs/rebuild/rev118/receipts/MT5_ORIGINAL_MARGIN_SOURCE_20261028.json), [margin contract](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/blob/42d8b386e61f2ea26730d4232cab494b3173320e/docs/rebuild/rev118/backend/BE-009_010_MT5_ORIGINAL_MARGIN.md) and [original native compiler artifact](https://github.com/Vanguduza/Van/actions/runs/40651126241/artifacts/12800160977). Committed pre-push documents correctly recorded native compilation as pending; its verified later result is given here.
